summary: Add a visual of rates approaching dynamic equilibrium and strengthen calculation and interpretation practice around partial pressures and equilibrium changes.

improvements.where: note, after the first paragraph of ## Key ideas
improvements.why: Outcome 9701-7.1.1 requires equal forward and reverse rates at dynamic equilibrium; ER 9701 w23 P22 Q2 reports confusion between rate–time and concentration–time graphs, and the chapter currently has no diagram.
improvements.what: Use graph_sketch for forward and reverse reaction rate against time in a closed system: forward rate falls, reverse rate rises, and the curves meet at a nonzero common plateau. Mark the equilibrium time; explain that equal nonzero rates give constant, not necessarily equal, concentrations. Do not use the free_body hint, which is unrelated to chemistry.

improvements.why: The core practice has only one numeric item for mole fraction and one for constant calculations, while ER 9701 w23 P22 Q2 identifies direct substitution of moles into $K_p$ as a common error.
improvements.what: Add a linked set: calculate equilibrium mole fractions from a change table; turn these into partial pressures using total pressure; then calculate $K_p$ with stoichiometric powers and pressure units. Include a misconception distractor based on using mole amounts directly.

improvements.why: Most generated core questions are short restatements of rules, whereas the examiner reports test graph interpretation and conditions such as inert gas at constant volume.
improvements.what: Add one exam-style interpretation of a forward/reverse rate graph requiring explanation of the nonzero equal plateau and one application distinguishing inert-gas addition at constant volume from compression of the reacting gases.

improvements.where: note, ## Key ideas beside the definition of dynamic equilibrium
improvements.why: ER 9701 s22 P22 Q3 notes that candidates often gave equal rates but omitted the absence of change in measurable properties.
improvements.source: ER 9701 s22 P22 Q3 in build/work/bundles/9701-7.1.md
improvements.what: Add a concise observation-level explanation: in a closed system at equilibrium, macroscopic properties such as colour or pressure remain constant even though both reactions continue. Link this to the rate graph.
